title.narrative: EU support to the Eradication of PPR (Peste des petits ruminants) from Africa

description.narrative:
This Action will set the stage for the eradication of PPR in Sub-Saharan Africa, and will be the first phase comprising of the following:

ü Strengthening the capacity of regional/continental actors and institutions in a bid to ensure appropriate rollout of the eradication process.

ü Establishment of a solid eradication coordination framework.

Preparation and organization of the vaccination strategy.
